v2_rules.forward_model_flat: flat unless BOTH the slope of Judge B's predicted-outcome difference on its actual-outcome difference AND the pooled captured share of the between-candidate token difference over Judge B's four senses (planner route, 50 ms) have 95% body intervals entirely above 0
v2_rules.evaluator_flat: flat unless the slope of Judge B's actual-outcome difference on the grounded wellness difference (50 ms) has a 95% body interval entirely above 0
v2_rules.planner_ignores_predicted_wellness: the planner's objective gives predicted wellness weight 0 (intention_gen._wellness_w) and the chosen order's mean rank by predicted wellness is not better than chance (the interval's upper end is not below (K + 1) / 2)
v2_rules.depth_claim: looking further ahead causes a better physical decision only when the order selected by predicted wellness at 150 ms beats the order selected at 50 ms in actual grounded wellness averaged over the order's tenure, paired over the same starts, 95% body interval above 0

tie_band.definition: 90th percentile over candidate pairs of |predicted difference - grounded difference| one moment after the order, on the 0-to-5 sum

evaluator.definition: slope of Judge B's difference between two candidates' ACTUAL outcomes on their grounded wellness difference, one moment after (1 = sees the whole true difference, 0 = blind to it)

forward_model.definition: slope of Judge B's difference between two candidates' PREDICTED outcomes on its difference between their ACTUAL outcomes (1 = the forecast hands Judge B every difference reality does, 0 = none)

chain.definition: slope of the planner's predicted wellness difference on the grounded difference: the whole route the production tie is judged on

goal_distance_50ms.what: the planner's predicted distance to its goal 50 ms ahead against the actual distance 50 ms after each command ran from the same saved state

without_chosen.what: the planner's predicted distance to its goal 50 ms ahead against the actual distance 50 ms after each command ran from the same saved state (the four candidates the planner did not choose)

goal_distance_end.what: the same forecast against the actual distance to the goal at the end of the order's tenure

without_chosen.what: the same forecast against the actual distance to the goal at the end of the order's tenure (the four candidates the planner did not choose)

wellness_50ms.what: the planner route's predicted wellness 50 ms ahead (Judge B's five-term sum) against the grounded wellness 50 ms after each command

without_chosen.what: the planner route's predicted wellness 50 ms ahead (Judge B's five-term sum) against the grounded wellness 50 ms after each command (the four candidates the planner did not choose)

wellness_tenure.what: the same forecast against the grounded wellness averaged over the order's tenure

without_chosen.what: the same forecast against the grounded wellness averaged over the order's tenure (the four candidates the planner did not choose)

rules.statistic: of all pairs of candidate commands tried from the same saved state, how many in 100 the forecast's order picks the pair's actual winner (lower = better for both); 50 = chance, 80 to 90 = a ranking a planner can optimize
rules.ties: a pair whose actual outcomes differ by no more than 1 in 100 of that start's actual standard deviation has no winner and is left out; a pair the forecast scores exactly equal counts half right
rules.interval: 95%, whole bodies resampled with replacement, 5000 draws
rules.spread_ratio: median over starts of the standard deviation of the candidates' forecasts over that of their actual outcomes: 0 = the forecast gives every command the same outcome, 1 = it separates them as much as reality does
rules.case: better than chance when the interval's lower end is above 50: then case_3_planner_not_better when a planner's command does not beat the reference command its search started from in the actual outcome (paired body interval of planner minus reference not entirely below 0), else ranking_used (better_than_chance without a planner comparison). Below chance (the interval's upper end under 50): case_2_wrong_order. Otherwise case_1_under_separated when the spread ratio is below 1 and case_2_wrong_order when it is 1 or more; undetermined with fewer than two bodies or no pair with an actual winner

notes.planner_comparison: case 3 compares the chosen order with the controller's own proposal for the goal distances always, and for wellness only when the planner's objective weighs predicted wellness (planner_wellness_weight above 0): a planner that does not search on wellness cannot be faulted for not improving it
notes.without_chosen: each outcome's without_chosen block is the same statistic over the four candidates the planner did not choose (6 pairs a start): the chosen order was selected by searching this forecast, so the pairs containing it favor the forecast's own errors

rules.forward_model_flat: flat unless BOTH the slope of Judge B's predicted-outcome difference on its actual-outcome difference AND the pooled captured share of the between-candidate token difference over Judge B's four senses (planner route, 50 ms) have 95% body intervals entirely above 0
rules.evaluator_flat: flat unless the slope of Judge B's actual-outcome difference on the grounded wellness difference (50 ms) has a 95% body interval entirely above 0
rules.planner_ignores_predicted_wellness: the planner's objective gives predicted wellness weight 0 (intention_gen._wellness_w) and the chosen order's mean rank by predicted wellness is not better than chance (the interval's upper end is not below (K + 1) / 2)
rules.depth_claim: looking further ahead causes a better physical decision only when the order selected by predicted wellness at 150 ms beats the order selected at 50 ms in actual grounded wellness averaged over the order's tenure, paired over the same starts, 95% body interval above 0

forecast_scorer.definition: bodies split in halves; scale and bands measured on one half, pairs judged on the other, both ways; counts with exact one-sided sign tests (planner_repair_judge.py docstring)

forecast_scorer_with_extra_candidates.definition: bodies split in halves; scale and bands measured on one half, pairs judged on the other, both ways; counts with exact one-sided sign tests (planner_repair_judge.py docstring)

forecast_scorer_next.definition: bodies split in halves; scale and bands measured on one half, pairs judged on the other, both ways; counts with exact one-sided sign tests (planner_repair_judge.py docstring)

forward_model.definition: per body, the planner route's 50 ms captured share of the realised between-candidate token difference; passed when the bodies above 0 pass an exact one-sided sign test (p < 0.05)
